_comment: Single source of truth for mechanical essay checks. scripts/check_essay.py reads this file; prose rules in references/ cite it instead of repeating numbers. 'hard' findings fail the check, 'soft' findings are warnings to review.
banned_terms: 在这个飞速发展的时代

signature_phrases._comment: Phrases the skill itself used to prescribe; allowed at most 'max' times per essay so that essays written with this skill do not converge on the same verbal tics.
